post_meta.author: graniteandpine
post_meta.title: Mono Pass still white
post_meta.text: Mono out of Rock Creek 6/8. Continuous snow from Ruby Lake, firm and pleasant at 6am, sloppy by 9. No steep sections, spikes are plenty. Rock Creek is loud under the snow bridges, be smart about where you stand.

post_meta.author: u/blistercountclimbs
post_meta.title: Mono Pass (Rock Creek) with kids
post_meta.text: Took the kids up Mono Pass out of Mosquito Flat on the 4th. Patchy snow in the last half mile, totally walkable, the little ones loved the snowfield glissade near the top. Rock Creek footbridge means no wet feet. Great early summer option.
